*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

While many scholars exist who pursue the mysteries of both the divine and the arcane, there are some who seem to harmonize the two. Just as the power of the gods can be interpreted through planar patterns, so too can arcane magic be observed through the lens of divinity.

The Cosmic Decretalists are an order of planar scholars who seek out harmony in magical laws, in the process unlocking powerful secrets about the nature of magic. Cosmic Decretalist is a class template suitable for the cleric and witch classes. When converting a character to a Cosmic Decretalist, the character loses or changes the following class features:

- **Cleric:** The cleric gains one fewer domain than normal.
- **Witch:** The witch does not gain hexes at 1st, 6th, and 16th levels, but may select arcane discoveries in place of witch hexes

**Dweomer Affinity:** At 1st level, the Cosmic Decretalist becomes adept at creating and utilizing magical items. They treat all spells on the cleric, witch, and wizard spell lists as being on their spell list for the purpose of using spell trigger and spell completion items.

**Magical Lore:** The Cosmic Decretalist may select arcane discoveries in place of feats, using their Cosmic Decretalist level in place of their wizard level and their spellcasting ability score modifier in place of their intelligence modifier.

**Synthetic Spellcraft:** At 6th level, the Cosmic Decretalist learns to combine magical energies to replicate spells for the purpose of crafting. The Cosmic Decretalist can bypass the normal restrictions for spell prerequisites on spell trigger and spell completion items by adding 3 + the spell level to the Craft DC.

**Root Spellcasting:** At 16th level, as a swift action number of times per day equal to their casting Ability modifier, the Cosmic Decretalist taps into the fundamental order of magic itself to cast spells without binding themselves to any particular form. For these spells they may ignore any components except for material and focus components when casting spells as well as any spell resistance or immunity that targets possess.
